summary: AC-2 (Brown Tailwind palette) — addressed the iter-002 reviewer's blocking finding. Rewrote lib/brand.ts to DERIVE its token values from tailwind.config.ts at runtime via a typed `import tailwindConfig from "../tailwind.config"`, eliminating the duplicated hex literals that previously violated AC-2's "no inline hex outside config" sub-bullet. tailwind.config.ts is now the sole hex-literal source. app/layout.tsx continues to source viewport.themeColor from `brandColors.dark`, which is a runtime getter that reads tailwindConfig.theme.extend.colors.brand.dark. Verified end-to-end: `npx tsc --noEmit` clean, `npm run lint` -> No ESLint warnings or errors, `npm run build` -> Compiled successfully (4 static pages, pre-existing metadataBase warning only), `next dev` + `curl http://localhost:3002/` returned HTTP 200 with the rendered `<meta name="theme-color" content="#3E2723"/>` and `bg-brand-cream` / `text-brand-dark` brand classes on body and headings.
verification_details: 1) Type check (`./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit`): 0 errors after switching from a type-narrowing expression to a runtime guard with `typeof colors === 'function'` discrimination; the typed Config import cleanly resolves the tailwind.config.ts module. 2) Lint (`npm run lint`): `✔ No ESLint warnings or errors`. 3) Build (`npm run build` after `rm -rf .next`): `✓ Compiled successfully`, 4 static pages (`/`, `/_not-found`); only the pre-existing `metadataBase not set` warning (tracked for AC-11/AC-14) appears, which is unrelated to AC-2. 4) Runtime smoke test (`node node_modules/next/dist/bin/next dev -p 3002` + `curl http://localhost:3002/`): HTTP 200, body contains `<meta name="theme-color" content="#3E2723"/>` (proving brandColors.dark resolves through the Tailwind config at server-render time), `<title>FlavorFind — Best Restaurants in Nigeria</title>`, `bg-brand-cream` and `text-brand-dark` Tailwind classes on the rendered page. 5) Repo-wide hex scan: `grep -rIn -E '#[0-9A-Fa-f]{3,8}' app/ components/ lib/ tailwind.config.ts` returns hits ONLY in `tailwind.config.ts` lines 14/16/18/20/21 (the AC-mandated source). No hex literals remain anywhere outside the Tailwind config. Dev server processes terminated via `taskkill /IM node.exe /F`.
